faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this article, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Basic local exchange service
means and includes the business and occupation of providing to residents as later
               defined herein the ability to originate and terminate visual and/or voice grade communications
               through the local network with substantially all other residents having telephone
               or radio telephone stations regardless whether the provider owns, leases, or uses
               for a fee such local network. This is intended to be an inclusive definition without
               regard to whether a particular provider is regulated by the Colorado Public Utilities
               Commission.
Basic local exchange service provider
or
new provider
means any company or entity other than the incumbent provider who enters the business
               of providing basic local exchange service.
Line
means a separate telephone number or telephone circuit identification number provided
               to a resident at retail, except that, to the extent a provider provides basic local
               exchange service through trunks, a line means a network access register, or its functional
               equivalent, provided to a resident at retail. The provisions of wireless, cable, mobile
               radio, or other technologies for the purpose of providing basic local exchange service
               to any business or entity shall be deemed the provision of lines under this article
               and will be applicable to this tax.
Local network
means the physical plant having the capacity to transmit and receive visual and/or
               verbal communication which are directed from one resident to another resident's specific
               apparatus, either at a fixed location or mobile by an identification code, (i.e.,
               telephone number) of the transmitter's choosing at the time the communication is initiated.
Provider
means the companies or entities providing basic local exchange service in the city.
Provider's current line count
means the number of lines for which a provider provides basic local exchange service
               during the current month within the city under
section 98-33
.
Resident
means any individual, corporation, partnership, joint venture, company, firm, association,
               proprietorship or other entity residing or having a place of business within the city.
(Code 1981, § 31-17; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
